name: Highest prime primitive root (less than p) for the n-th prime p. (or 0 if none exists).
link: Robert Israel, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..10000
maple: for k from p-1 to 1 by -1 do
if numtheory:-order(k,p) = p-1 and isprime(k) then return k fi
mathematica: Reap[For[p = 2, p<1000, p = NextPrime[p], s = Select[PrimitiveRootList[p], PrimeQ]; Sow[If[s == {}, 0, Last[s]]]]][[2, 1]] (* _Jean-François Alcover_, Sep 03 2016 *)
